question: How much time off do I get per year?
queries: How much time off do I get per year?
annual paid leave days per calendar year
sick days paid leave part-time employees

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Annual paid leave
results.text: Full-time employees earn 20 days of paid leave per calendar year, accrued at 1.67 days per month.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Part-time employees
results.text: Part-time employees earn paid leave in proportion to their contracted hours. An employee contracted for 20 hours a week earns 10 days per year.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Sick days
results.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year, separate from annual paid leave. Unused sick days do not carry over.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Carryover
results.text: Up to 5 unused days of paid leave may be carried into the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire if they are not used by March 31.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Contractor leave
results.text: Contractors are not eligible for paid leave, sick leave or parental leave under this policy. Their time away is governed by their contract.
